| description =  

It's placeholder is [[a scaled wolf]] or [[a scaled wolf hunter]] with a 6m 40s spawn time. There are very few Chokidai in the west valley of the Field of Bone, so finding the placeholders is very easy.

Seems to always at drop least 1 of the Scaled Prowler items.

Be careful at the NW spawn as [[an iksar marauder]] paths along the wall, from (80, 3500) up to (1250, 3500); the marauder can be obscured by the surrounding foilage.
